market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $40,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$77,160 on Apr 29, 2026. Feb 2026 low was $60,033. Reaching $40K requires another ~33% drop from that floor or ~48% from spot. Annual drawdowns of that magnitude in a recovery phase are tail events; only the deepest bear analysts call $35-40K bottoms. ~8% captures that tail without dismissing it.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severe systemic shock causing capitulation well beyond February's low.
